06 — Laporan modeling ASD vs TD (ABIDE I, sMRI T1w + fenotipik)¶

Notebook ini hanya MEMBACA hasil runner (src/run_pilot_v2.py) — tidak ada model yang dilatih ulang. Untuk data penuh cukup ganti sel CONFIG lalu Restart & Run All.

Alur penelitian: preprocessing 05c (reorient → N4 → HD-BET → registrasi afin ANTs ke MNI152 → 2 mm → crop 96×112×96 → z-score di mask) → split (folds.csv, 5 fold strat. site×label; inner validation 20 % per fold; test held-out 149 subjek tidak disentuh) → fenotipik (usia, jenis kelamin, FIQ, volume otak) → ROI (atlas Harvard-Oxford, mean & SD intensitas, ± ComBat) → citra 2.5D (15 slice, 3 bidang) & 3D → fusion (stacking / rata-rata / PCA) & ensemble → evaluasi (OOF test per fold, bootstrap CI).

Aturan yang dijaga: semua transform di-fit di train fold; seleksi model dari AUC pooled inner validation, bukan skor test; threshold 0,5 tetap (ditetapkan sebelum melihat hasil) dan, sebagai versi kedua, threshold Youden per fold dari inner validation (aturan dikunci 2026-10-27); SITE_ID dan kolom klinis tidak pernah menjadi fitur. Hasil CNN dari nol v2 tidak valid (bug BN) dan diganti rerun setelah bugfix; hasil lama tetap ditampilkan dengan tanda. Tabel di bawah sel konfigurasi mendaftar semua model per kelompok beserta statusnya.

CONFIG¶

Satu-satunya sel yang diganti untuk data penuh: RESULT_DIR, SUBSET, dan (untuk data penuh) LOCKED_CONFIG menunjuk ke file kandidat terkunci dari pilot. THRESHOLD tetap 0,5 dan diperiksa sama dengan threshold runner.

Daftar model per kelompok¶

Kelompok: klasik (ML/CNN klasik), modern (arsitektur modern), foundation (model fondasi beku), dari nol (CNN tanpa pretraining). Status: kandidat terkunci (dibawa ke data penuh), diuji – dikeluarkan (dengan alasan dari locked_config_kandidat.json), ditunda.

In [3]:
def kelompok4(g):
    g = g.lower()
    if "dari nol" in g: return "dari nol"
    if "foundation" in g: return "foundation"
    if "modern" in g: return "modern"
    return "klasik"

def alasan_keluar(n):
    for key, why in LOCKED.get("dikeluarkan", {}).items():
        toks = set()
        for t in re.findall(r"[a-z0-9_*()]+", key.lower()):
            if "(_cb)" in t:
                b = t.replace("(_cb)", ""); toks |= {b, b + "_cb"}
            else:
                toks.add(t)
        hit = n in toks or ("roi_*_tanpa_combat" in toks and n.startswith("roi_") and not n.endswith("_cb"))
        if hit: return why
    return "AUC inner val di bawah kandidat terpilih"

status_df = pc.read_status(RESULT_DIR)
rows = []
for mod, names in MODALITY.items():
    for n in names:
        hp = CFG["models"][n]
        st = status_df[status_df.model == n]["status"].value_counts().to_dict()
        rows.append({"modalitas": MOD_LABEL[mod], "model": n, "kelompok": kelompok4(hp["group"]), "grup asli": hp["group"],
                     "unit run": ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in st.items()),
                     "status": "kandidat terkunci" if n in LOCKED_MODELS else "diuji – dikeluarkan",
                     "alasan": ("" if n in LOCKED_MODELS else alasan_keluar(n))
                               + (" | hasil v2 TIDAK VALID (bug BN) -> dipakai rerun bugfix BN" if n in BNFIX_MODELS else "")})
for n, why in CFG.get("deferred", {}).items():
    rows.append({"modalitas": "-", "model": n, "kelompok": "-", "grup asli": "-", "unit run": "-", "status": "ditunda", "alasan": why})
model_list = export("00_daftar_model", pd.DataFrame(rows))
display(model_list)

1. Lingkungan & provenance¶

Mencatat versi library, GPU, config_hash runner, fingerprint preprocessing, dan hash file split. Hash folds.csv dan subset_20pct.csv harus sama dengan yang tercatat saat run — jika berubah, notebook berhenti. Hasil disimpan ke report/environment.json.

import importlib.metadata as md_
import torch

    try: return md_.version(n)
    except md_.PackageNotFoundError: return None

LIBS = ["numpy", "pandas", "scipy", "scikit-learn", "torch", "torchvision", "timm", "xgboost", "lightgbm", "tabm",
        "neuroHarmonize", "neuroCombat", "nibabel", "matplotlib"]

       "versi_library": {n: ver(n) for n in LIBS},
       "gpu": torch.cuda.get_device_name(0) if torch.cuda.is_available() else None,
       "cuda": torch.version.cuda, "cudnn": torch.backends.cudnn.version() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None,
       "config_hash_runner": CONFIG_HASH, "config_hash_dibuat": CFGJ.get("created"),

3. Split & audit kebocoran¶

Tabel fold × partisi × label. Assert: (a) tidak ada subjek yang muncul di dua partisi dalam satu fold; (b) tiap subjek dev muncul tepat sekali sebagai test; (c) partisi test sama dengan fold_strat di folds.csv; (d) 149 subjek test held-out tidak ada di prediksi, embedding, maupun cache mana pun; (e) kedua kelas ada di tiap partisi.

In [6]:
lab = cohort.set_index("SUB_ID")["label"]
rows = []
for k, s in SPLITS.items():
    for part, ids in s.items():
        rows.append({"fold": k, "partisi": part, "n": len(ids), "ASD": int(lab.loc[ids].sum()), "TD": int((1 - lab.loc[ids]).sum())})
split_tab = pd.DataFrame(rows)
display(split_tab.pivot(index="fold", columns="partisi", values=["n", "ASD", "TD"]))
export("03_split", split_tab)

fcsv = pd.read_csv(PROJECT / "data" / "folds.csv")
cohort_ids = set(cohort.SUB_ID)
for k, s in SPLITS.items():
    parts = list(s)
    for i, a in enumerate(parts):
        for b in parts[i + 1:]:
            ov = set(s[a]) & set(s[b])
            assert not ov, f"fold {k}: overlap {a} vs {b}: {sorted(ov)[:5]}"
    assert set(np.concatenate(list(s.values()))) == cohort_ids, f"fold {k}: partisi tidak menutup seluruh kohort"
    assert set(s["test"]) == set(cohort.loc[cohort.fold_strat == k, "SUB_ID"]), f"fold {k}: test != fold_strat folds.csv"
    for part, ids in s.items():
        assert lab.loc[ids].nunique() == 2, f"fold {k} partisi {part}: hanya satu kelas"
test_all = np.concatenate([s["test"] for s in SPLITS.values()])
assert len(test_all) == len(set(test_all)) == len(cohort_ids), "subjek dev tidak muncul tepat 1x sebagai test"

heldout = set(fcsv.loc[fcsv.split == "test", "SUB_ID"].astype(int))
assert heldout and not (heldout & cohort_ids), "test held-out masuk kohort!"
seen = set()
_dirs = [RESULT_DIR] + ([BNFIX_DIR] if BNFIX_MODELS else [])
for f in [f for d_ in _dirs for f in d_.glob("units/*/fold*/preds.csv")] + ([FUSION_INNER] if FUSION_INNER.exists() else []):
    seen |= set(pd.read_csv(f, usecols=["SUB_ID"]).SUB_ID.astype(int))
for f in [f for d_ in _dirs for f in d_.glob("units/*/fold*/emb.npz")]:
    z = np.load(f)
    for key in z.files:
        if key.startswith("ids_"): seen |= set(z[key].astype(int))
for f in RESULT_DIR.glob("cache/*/*.npy"):
    if f.stem.isdigit(): seen.add(int(f.stem))
leak = heldout & seen
assert not leak, f"{len(leak)} subjek test held-out muncul di hasil: {sorted(leak)[:10]}"
assert seen <= cohort_ids, f"ada subjek di hasil yang bukan anggota kohort: {sorted(seen - cohort_ids)[:10]}"
print(f"AUDIT SPLIT LULUS: {len(SPLITS)} fold, tanpa overlap; {len(test_all)} subjek dev masing-masing 1x test; "
      f"{len(heldout)} subjek held-out tidak ada di {len(seen)} subjek yang muncul di prediksi/embedding/cache.")

6. Metrik per eksperimen¶

Accuracy, balanced accuracy, precision (ASD), recall/sensitivitas ASD, spesifisitas TD, F1 macro, ROC-AUC pada threshold tetap 0,5. Dua tabel: mean ± SD antar fold dan pooled OOF + 95 % CI bootstrap (2000×, seed 42 — resampling identik dengan runner, sehingga angka BA/F1/AUC/Sens/Spes sama persis dengan tabel A–E; diperiksa dengan assert).

In [9]:
from scipy.stats import rankdata
KEYS = ["accuracy", "balanced_accuracy", "precision", "sensitivity", "specificity", "f1_macro", "auc"]
SHORT = {"accuracy": "Acc", "balanced_accuracy": "BA", "precision": "Prec", "sensitivity": "Sens", "specificity": "Spes",
         "f1_macro": "F1m", "auc": "AUC"}

def metrics_full(y, p, thr=THRESHOLD):
    y = np.asarray(y).astype(int); p = np.asarray(p, float); yh = (p >= thr).astype(int)
    tp = int(((yh == 1) & (y == 1)).sum()); tn = int(((yh == 0) & (y == 0)).sum())
    fp = int(((yh == 1) & (y == 0)).sum()); fn = int(((yh == 0) & (y == 1)).sum())
    pos, neg = tp + fn, tn + fp
    sens = tp / pos if pos else np.nan; spec = tn / neg if neg else np.nan
    f1p = 2 * tp / (2 * tp + fp + fn) if (2 * tp + fp + fn) else 0.0
    f1n = 2 * tn / (2 * tn + fn + fp) if (2 * tn + fn + fp) else 0.0
    auc = (rankdata(p)[y == 1].sum() - pos * (pos + 1) / 2) / (pos * neg) if pos and neg else np.nan
    return {"accuracy": (tp + tn) / len(y), "balanced_accuracy": (sens + spec) / 2 if pos and neg else np.nan,
            "precision": tp / (tp + fp) if tp + fp else 0.0, "sensitivity": sens, "specificity": spec,
            "f1_macro": (f1p + f1n) / 2, "auc": auc}

def bootstrap_full(y, p, n=CFG["bootstrap_n"], seed=42, thr=THRESHOLD):
    # resampling identik dengan pc.bootstrap_ci (rng, urutan, aturan lewati resample satu kelas); thr boleh per subjek
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed); y = np.asarray(y).astype(int); p = np.asarray(p, float)
    vals = {k: [] for k in KEYS}
    for _ in range(n):
        i = rng.integers(0, len(y), len(y))
        if y[i].min() == y[i].max(): continue
        m = metrics_full(y[i], p[i], np.asarray(thr)[i] if np.ndim(thr) else thr)
        for k in KEYS: vals[k].append(m[k])
    return {k: (float(np.nanpercentile(v, 2.5)), float(np.nanpercentile(v, 97.5))) for k, v in vals.items()}

RES, FOLD_ROWS = {}, []
for name, t in EXP.items():
    pooled = metrics_full(t.label, t.prob); ci = bootstrap_full(t.label.to_numpy(), t.prob.to_numpy())
    pf = pd.DataFrame([{"fold": k, **metrics_full(g.label, g.prob)} for k, g in t.groupby("fold")])
    FOLD_ROWS += [{"eksperimen": name, **r} for r in pf.to_dict("records")]
    RES[name] = {"pooled": pooled, "ci": ci, "fold_mean": pf[KEYS].mean().to_dict(), "fold_sd": pf[KEYS].std(ddof=1).to_dict()}

def fmt_ci(n, k): return f"{RES[n]['pooled'][k]:.3f} [{RES[n]['ci'][k][0]:.3f}, {RES[n]['ci'][k][1]:.3f}]"
def fmt_fold(n, k, sep=" ± "): return f"{RES[n]['fold_mean'][k]:.3f}{sep}{RES[n]['fold_sd'][k]:.3f}"
base = lambda n: {"eksperimen": n, "modalitas": EXP_META[n]["modalitas"], "metode": EXP_META[n]["metode"],
                  "kandidat terkunci": "✓" if n in LOCKED_MODELS else ""}
tab_fold = export("06_metrik_fold_mean_sd", pd.DataFrame([{**base(n), **{SHORT[k]: fmt_fold(n, k) for k in KEYS}} for n in RES]))
tab_pool = export("06_metrik_pooled_ci", pd.DataFrame([{**base(n), "n": len(EXP[n]), **{f"{SHORT[k]} [95% CI]": fmt_ci(n, k) for k in KEYS}} for n in RES]))
export("06_metrik_per_fold_mentah", pd.DataFrame(FOLD_ROWS))

# ---- konsistensi dengan tabel runner (angka tidak boleh berbeda) ----
chk = 0
for r in TABLES["tabel_A_fenotipik"].to_dict("records"):
    n = r["model"]
    for k in ("balanced_accuracy", "auc"):
        assert r[f"{SHORT[k]} pooled [95% CI]"] == fmt_ci(n, k), f"Tabel A {n} {k}: {r[f'{SHORT[k]} pooled [95% CI]']} != {fmt_ci(n, k)}"
        chk += 1
    for k in ("balanced_accuracy", "f1_macro", "auc", "sensitivity", "specificity"):
        assert r[f"{SHORT[k]} (mean±SD)"] == fmt_fold(n, k, "±"), f"Tabel A {n} {k} fold"
        chk += 1
for tn, key in (("tabel_B_citra_v2", lambda r: r["model"]), ("tabel_ROI", lambda r: r["model"]),
                ("tabel_fusion_ensemble", lambda r: f"{r['skenario']}|{r['metode']}")):
    for r in TABLES[tn].to_dict("records"):
        n = key(r)
        n = OLD_KEY.get(n, n) if tn == "tabel_B_citra_v2" else n     # tabel runner utama = hasil lama
        if n not in RES: continue
        for k in ("balanced_accuracy", "f1_macro", "auc", "sensitivity", "specificity"):
            assert r[f"{SHORT[k]} pooled [95% CI]"] == fmt_ci(n, k), f"{tn} {n} {k}: {r[f'{SHORT[k]} pooled [95% CI]']} != {fmt_ci(n, k)}"
            assert r[f"{SHORT[k]} fold"] == fmt_fold(n, k), f"{tn} {n} {k} fold"
            chk += 2
if BNFIX_MODELS:                                                     # tabel runner rerun bugfix
    tbx = pd.read_csv(BNFIX_DIR / "tables" / "tabel_B_citra_v2.csv")
    for r in tbx[tbx.model.isin(BNFIX_MODELS)].to_dict("records"):
        for k in ("balanced_accuracy", "f1_macro", "auc", "sensitivity", "specificity"):
            assert r[f"{SHORT[k]} pooled [95% CI]"] == fmt_ci(r["model"], k), f"bnfix {r['model']} {k}"
            chk += 1
print(f"Konsistensi dengan tabel runner: {chk} nilai identik.")
display(Markdown("**Mean ± SD antar fold (test tiap fold)**")); display(tab_fold)
display(Markdown("**Pooled OOF + 95 % CI bootstrap**")); display(tab_pool)
display(Markdown("> **Catatan otomatis:** SD antar fold menggambarkan variasi antar fold (±" +
                 f"{int(np.mean([len(s['test']) for s in SPLITS.values()]))} subjek test per fold), **bukan** interval kepercayaan. "
                 "Ketidakpastian estimasi dibaca dari 95 % CI bootstrap pooled OOF."))

7. Tabel per modalitas¶

Angka diambil langsung dari tabel runner (tables/*.csv). Kolom kandidat terkunci berasal dari locked_config_kandidat.json (seleksi inner validation) — bukan "terbaik di test". Pada fusion, metode utama yang ditetapkan sebelum melihat hasil adalah F1_stack_logreg.

def mark(df, col="model"):
    df = df.copy(); df.insert(1, "kandidat terkunci", df[col].map(lambda n: "✓" if n in LOCKED_MODELS else "")); return df
tA = mark(TABLES["tabel_A_fenotipik"].drop(columns=[c for c in TABLES["tabel_A_fenotipik"].columns if c.startswith("_")] + ["terbaik"]))
tB = mark(TABLES["tabel_ROI"])
tC = TABLES["tabel_B_citra_v2"].copy()
tC.insert(2, "status hasil", tC.model.map(lambda n: "TIDAK VALID (bug BN)" if n in BNFIX_MODELS else "valid"))
tC["model"] = tC.model.map(lambda n: OLD_KEY.get(n, n))
if BNFIX_MODELS:
    tbx = pd.read_csv(BNFIX_DIR / "tables" / "tabel_B_citra_v2.csv")
    tbx = tbx[tbx.model.isin(BNFIX_MODELS)].copy(); tbx.insert(2, "status hasil", "bugfix BN (rerun)")
    tC = pd.concat([tC, tbx], ignore_index=True)
tC = mark(tC)
tD = TABLES["tabel_fusion_ensemble"].copy()
tD.insert(2, "peran", tD.metode.map(lambda m: "utama (pra-ditetapkan)" if m == LOCKED["fusion"]["utama"] else "pembanding"))
tD["catatan"] = [EXP_META.get(f"{r.skenario}|{r.metode}", {}).get("catatan", "") for r in tD.itertuples()]
for title, name, df in [("A — Fenotipik", "07A_fenotipik", tA), ("B — ROI Harvard-Oxford (dengan/tanpa ComBat)", "07B_roi", tB),
                        ("C — Citra 2.5D & 3D (params, VRAM, waktu)", "07C_citra", tC), ("D — Fusion & ensemble", "07D_fusion", tD)]:
    display(Markdown(f"**Tabel {title}**")); display(export(name, df))

8. Ablasi modalitas¶

Fenotipik vs ROI vs citra vs fusion: BA, AUC, dan F1 macro pooled dengan error bar 95 % CI bootstrap. Yang ditampilkan hanya kandidat terkunci per modalitas dan fusion dengan metode utama (tidak ada pemilihan dari test).

In [11]:
abl = [n for n in LOCKED_MODELS if n in RES] + [f"{s}|{LOCKED['fusion']['utama']}" for s in CFG["fusion"]["scenarios"] if f"{s}|{LOCKED['fusion']['utama']}" in RES]
order = sorted(abl, key=lambda n: list(MOD_COLOR).index(EXP_META[n]["modalitas"]))
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(13, 0.32 * len(order) + 1.6), sharey=True)
for ax, k in zip(axes, ["balanced_accuracy", "auc", "f1_macro"]):
    y = np.arange(len(order))[::-1]
    val = [RES[n]["pooled"][k] for n in order]
    lo = [RES[n]["pooled"][k] - RES[n]["ci"][k][0] for n in order]; hi = [RES[n]["ci"][k][1] - RES[n]["pooled"][k] for n in order]
    ax.barh(y, val, height=0.6, color=[MOD_COLOR[EXP_META[n]["modalitas"]] for n in order], edgecolor="white", linewidth=2)
    ax.errorbar(val, y, xerr=[lo, hi], fmt="none", ecolor="#444", elinewidth=1, capsize=2)
    ax.axvline(0.5, color="#888", ls="--", lw=0.8); ax.set_xlim(0.3, 0.8); ax.set_title(SHORT[k] + " pooled (95% CI)")
    ax.grid(axis="y", visible=False)
axes[0].set_yticks(np.arange(len(order))[::-1]); axes[0].set_yticklabels([n.replace("|", " · ") for n in order])

9. Confusion matrix & classification report¶

Threshold tetap 0,5; baris = label sebenarnya (TD, ASD), kolom = prediksi. Angka = jumlah subjek, dalam kurung = % per baris. Untuk kandidat terkunci tiap modalitas dan semua varian fusion/ensemble. classification_report per eksperimen disimpan sebagai JSON dan tabel.

In [12]:
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix, classification_report
cm_exps = [n for n in LOCKED_MODELS if n in RES] + [n for n in RES if EXP_META[n]["modalitas"] == "fusion"]
nc = 5; nr = int(np.ceil(len(cm_exps) / nc))
fig, axes = plt.subplots(nr, nc, figsize=(2.7 * nc, 2.6 * nr))
blues = matplotlib.colors.LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list("b", ["#ffffff", "#9ec5f4", "#2a78d6", "#104281"])
reports = {}
for ax, n in zip(axes.flat, cm_exps):
    t = EXP[n]; yh = (t.prob.to_numpy() >= THRESHOLD).astype(int)
    cm = confusion_matrix(t.label, yh, labels=[0, 1]); pct = cm / cm.sum(1, keepdims=True) * 100
    ax.imshow(pct, cmap=blues, vmin=0, vmax=100); ax.grid(False)
    for i in range(2):
        for j in range(2):
            ax.text(j, i, f"{cm[i, j]}\n({pct[i, j]:.0f}%)", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8, color="white" if pct[i, j] > 55 else "#222")
    ax.set_xticks([0, 1], ["TD", "ASD"]); ax.set_yticks([0, 1], ["TD", "ASD"]); ax.set_xlabel("prediksi", fontsize=7); ax.set_ylabel("sebenarnya", fontsize=7)
    ax.set_title(n.replace("|", "\n"), fontsize=7)
    reports[n] = classification_report(t.label, yh, labels=[0, 1], target_names=["TD", "ASD"], output_dict=True, zero_division=0)
for ax in list(axes.flat)[len(cm_exps):]: ax.axis("off")
fig.suptitle(f"Confusion matrix (threshold tetap {THRESHOLD})", fontsize=10); fig.tight_layout()
savefig(fig, "09_confusion_matrix"); plt.show()
(REPORT_DIR / "classification_reports.json").write_text(json.dumps(reports, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
rep_rows = []
for n, r in reports.items():
    for cls in ("TD", "ASD", "macro avg"):
        rep_rows.append({"eksperimen": n, "kelas": cls, "precision": round(r[cls]["precision"], 3), "recall": round(r[cls]["recall"], 3),
                         "f1": round(r[cls]["f1-score"], 3), "support": int(r[cls]["support"]), "accuracy": round(r["accuracy"], 3)})

Satu panel per modalitas (semua model di modalitas tsb; fusion = metode utama tiap skenario + ensemble), lalu satu gambar perbandingan: kandidat pertama tiap kelompok terkunci (urutan inner validation) dan fusion metode utama. Garis diagonal = acak.

Bukti per model citra: overfit test (apakah pipeline training bisa menghafal 16 subjek), jumlah fold "sudah belajar", seberapa kuat embedding menyandikan site, AUC inner validation dan test. Kolom penyebab utama adalah interpretasi dari bukti tersebut.

    return "" if r is None else f"{'lulus' if r['lulus'] else 'GAGAL'} (eval loss {r['eval loss']:.3f}, acc {r['eval acc']:.2f})"

    sb = site_ba.get(n)
    if n in ("scratch2d", "scratch3d"):
        return ("Bug BatchNorm: running stats basi saat eval -> prediksi jatuh ke satu kelas (overfit test gagal, lulus setelah bugfix). "
                "Setelah bugfix tersisa keterbatasan data: ±128 subjek latih per fold untuk CNN dari nol.")
    if n.startswith("sfcn"):
        return ("Domain mismatch: bobot brain age UK Biobank (usia 42–82 th, preprocessing FSL berbeda); cek kewajaran gagal"
                + (f" (r = {sfcn_r['pearson_r']:.2f}, SD prediksi {sfcn_r['pred_sd']:.2f} th)" if sfcn_r else "") + " -> fitur tidak informatif.")
    if n.startswith("dinov2"):
        return (f"Fitur foundation model gambar natural 2D menyandikan site paling kuat (BA site {sb:.2f}); head cepat overfit "
                "(val loss naik sejak epoch awal).")
    return (f"Pipeline benar (overfit test lulus). Val loss ≈ prediksi konstan; train loss hanya turun di fold yang lalu overfit -> "
            f"sinyal diagnosis per subjek lemah untuk ±128 subjek latih; embedding lebih banyak menyandikan site (BA site {sb:.2f}).")

12b. Sebelum vs sesudah: bugfix BN & threshold Youden¶

Bugfix BN (CNN dari nol): hasil lama (tidak valid) vs rerun dengan kalibrasi ulang statistik BN, threshold 0,5. Threshold Youden: per fold dipilih dari probabilitas inner validation (maks sensitivitas + spesifisitas − 1), lalu diterapkan ke test fold yang sama; AUC tidak berubah karena tidak bergantung threshold. Selisih diuji dengan bootstrap berpasangan (subjek yang sama, 2000×, seed 42); CI 95 % yang mencakup 0 = belum signifikan.

In [17]:
def youden_vec(name):
    # threshold per subjek test = threshold Youden fold-nya, dari probabilitas inner (bukan test)
    if name not in INNER: return None, None
    t, inn = EXP[name], INNER[name]
    thr = {int(k): pc.youden_threshold(g.label, g.prob) for k, g in inn.groupby("fold")}
    if set(thr) != set(t.fold.astype(int)): return None, None
    return t.fold.astype(int).map(thr).to_numpy(float), thr

def paired_delta(y, pa, ta, pb, tb, keys, n=CFG["bootstrap_n"], seed=42):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed); y = np.asarray(y).astype(int)
    pa, pb = np.asarray(pa, float), np.asarray(pb, float)
    ta_, tb_ = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(ta, float), y.shape), np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(tb, float), y.shape)
    point = {k: metrics_full(y, pb, tb_)[k] - metrics_full(y, pa, ta_)[k] for k in keys}
    d = {k: [] for k in keys}
    for _ in range(n):
        i = rng.integers(0, len(y), len(y))
        if y[i].min() == y[i].max(): continue
        ma, mb = metrics_full(y[i], pa[i], ta_[i]), metrics_full(y[i], pb[i], tb_[i])
        for k in keys: d[k].append(mb[k] - ma[k])
    return {k: (point[k], float(np.nanpercentile(d[k], 2.5)), float(np.nanpercentile(d[k], 97.5))) for k in keys}

def fmt_d(t): return f"{t[0]:+.3f} [{t[1]:+.3f}, {t[2]:+.3f}]"
def signif(t): return "naik (signifikan)" if t[1] > 0 else ("turun (signifikan)" if t[2] < 0 else "tidak signifikan")
DELTAS = []

# ---- bugfix BN ----
rows = []
for n in BNFIX_MODELS:
    a = EXP[OLD_KEY[n]].set_index("SUB_ID"); b = EXP[n].set_index("SUB_ID").loc[a.index]
    for lbl, key, rd, run in (("lama (bug BN)", OLD_KEY[n], RESULT_DIR, "utama"), ("bugfix BN", n, BNFIX_DIR, "_bnfix")):
        rows.append({"model": n, "versi": lbl, "overfit test": of_txt(run, n), "sudah belajar": learned_txt(n, rd),
                     "AUC inner val": round(metrics_full(INNER[key].label, INNER[key].prob)["auc"], 3),
                     **{f"{SHORT[k]} @0,5 [95% CI]": fmt_ci(key, k) for k in ("balanced_accuracy", "auc", "f1_macro")}})
    dl = paired_delta(a.label, a.prob, THRESHOLD, b.prob, THRESHOLD, ["balanced_accuracy", "auc", "f1_macro"])
    rows.append({"model": n, "versi": "Δ (bugfix − lama)", **{f"{SHORT[k]} @0,5 [95% CI]": fmt_d(v) for k, v in dl.items()},
                 "uji Δ (CI 95% berpasangan)": ", ".join(f"{SHORT[k]}: {signif(v)}" for k, v in dl.items())})
    DELTAS += [("bugfix BN", n, k, v) for k, v in dl.items()]
if rows:
    display(Markdown("**Bugfix BN — sebelum vs sesudah (threshold 0,5)**")); display(export("12b_bugfix_bn", pd.DataFrame(rows)))
else:
    display(Markdown("_Rerun bugfix BN belum ada (`BNFIX_DIR`)._"))

# ---- threshold Youden ----
YOUDEN = {}
y_exps = [n for n in LOCKED_MODELS if n in RES] + [n for n in RES if EXP_META[n]["modalitas"] == "fusion"]
rows, thr_rows = [], []
for n in y_exps:
    tv, thr = youden_vec(n)
    if tv is None:
        rows.append({"eksperimen": n, "catatan": "probabilitas inner tidak tersedia"}); continue
    YOUDEN[n] = tv
    t = EXP[n]; my = metrics_full(t.label, t.prob, tv); ciy = bootstrap_full(t.label.to_numpy(), t.prob.to_numpy(), thr=tv)
    dl = paired_delta(t.label, t.prob, THRESHOLD, t.prob, tv, ["balanced_accuracy", "f1_macro", "sensitivity", "specificity"])
    DELTAS += [("Youden vs 0,5", n, k, v) for k, v in dl.items() if k in ("balanced_accuracy", "f1_macro")]
    thr_rows += [{"eksperimen": n, "fold": k, "threshold Youden": round(v, 4)} for k, v in thr.items()]
    rows.append({"eksperimen": n, "modalitas": MOD_LABEL.get(EXP_META[n]["modalitas"], EXP_META[n]["modalitas"]),
                 "threshold (mean ± SD fold)": f"{np.mean(list(thr.values())):.3f} ± {np.std(list(thr.values()), ddof=1):.3f}",
                 "BA @0,5": fmt_ci(n, "balanced_accuracy"), "BA @Youden": f"{my['balanced_accuracy']:.3f} [{ciy['balanced_accuracy'][0]:.3f}, {ciy['balanced_accuracy'][1]:.3f}]",
                 "ΔBA [95% CI]": fmt_d(dl["balanced_accuracy"]),
                 "F1m @0,5": fmt_ci(n, "f1_macro"), "F1m @Youden": f"{my['f1_macro']:.3f} [{ciy['f1_macro'][0]:.3f}, {ciy['f1_macro'][1]:.3f}]",
                 "ΔF1m [95% CI]": fmt_d(dl["f1_macro"]),
                 "Sens/Spes @0,5": f"{RES[n]['pooled']['sensitivity']:.2f} / {RES[n]['pooled']['specificity']:.2f}",
                 "Sens/Spes @Youden": f"{my['sensitivity']:.2f} / {my['specificity']:.2f}",
                 "AUC (tidak berubah)": f"{RES[n]['pooled']['auc']:.3f}",
                 "ΔBA": signif(dl["balanced_accuracy"]), "ΔF1m": signif(dl["f1_macro"]), "catatan": EXP_META[n].get("catatan", "")})
display(Markdown("**Threshold 0,5 vs Youden (inner validation)** — pooled OOF test, 95 % CI bootstrap"))
display(export("12b_threshold_youden", pd.DataFrame(rows)))
export("12b_threshold_youden_per_fold", pd.DataFrame(thr_rows))

up = [(a, b, c) for a, b, c, v in DELTAS if v[1] > 0]
down = [(a, b, c) for a, b, c, v in DELTAS if v[2] < 0]
lst = lambda xs: "; ".join(f"{a}: {b} {SHORT[c]}" for a, b, c in xs)
dba_y = [v[0] for a, b, c, v in DELTAS if a == "Youden vs 0,5" and c == "balanced_accuracy"]
SIG_NOTE = (f"Dari {len(DELTAS)} perbandingan sebelum/sesudah (bugfix BN: BA/AUC/F1; Youden: BA/F1), "
            f"{len(up)} naik secara signifikan" + (f" ({lst(up)})" if up else "") + f", {len(down)} turun secara signifikan"
            + (f" ({lst(down)})" if down else "") + ", sisanya CI 95 % bootstrap berpasangan mencakup 0 (tanpa koreksi perbandingan berganda). "
            + ("**Tidak ada perbaikan yang signifikan secara statistik pada n = " + str(len(cohort_ids)) + ".** " if not up else
               "**Perbaikan di n = " + str(len(cohort_ids)) + " belum dapat dianggap signifikan secara statistik** (tanpa koreksi perbandingan berganda). ")
            + (f"Threshold Youden menurunkan BA pada {sum(d < 0 for d in dba_y)} dari {len(dba_y)} eksperimen: threshold yang dipilih dari "
               "±32 subjek inner validation per fold tidak stabil (SD antar fold besar), sehingga pada pilot tidak memperbaiki klasifikasi. "
               if dba_y else "")
            + "Perubahan threshold hanya menggeser trade-off sensitivitas–spesifisitas; AUC tetap.")

Catatan signifikansi: Dari 50 perbandingan sebelum/sesudah (bugfix BN: BA/AUC/F1; Youden: BA/F1), 0 naik secara signifikan, 6 turun secara signifikan (Youden vs 0,5: tabm BA; Youden vs 0,5: tabm F1m; Youden vs 0,5: P25|F1_mean_prob BA; Youden vs 0,5: P25|F1_mean_prob F1m; Youden vs 0,5: PRI|F2_pca16_logreg BA; Youden vs 0,5: PRI|F2_pca16_logreg F1m), sisanya CI 95 % bootstrap berpasangan mencakup 0 (tanpa koreksi perbandingan berganda). Tidak ada perbaikan yang signifikan secara statistik pada n = 200. Threshold Youden menurunkan BA pada 19 dari 22 eksperimen: threshold yang dipilih dari ±32 subjek inner validation per fold tidak stabil (SD antar fold besar), sehingga pada pilot tidak memperbaiki klasifikasi. Perubahan threshold hanya menggeser trade-off sensitivitas–spesifisitas; AUC tetap.

12c. Confusion matrix — threshold Youden¶

Eksperimen yang sama dengan tahap 9, tetapi tiap subjek test diklasifikasikan dengan threshold Youden fold-nya (dipilih dari inner validation). Bandingkan dengan gambar tahap 9 (threshold 0,5).

In [18]:
cm_y = [n for n in cm_exps if n in YOUDEN]
nc = 5; nr = int(np.ceil(len(cm_y) / nc))
fig, axes = plt.subplots(nr, nc, figsize=(2.7 * nc, 2.6 * nr), squeeze=False)
rep_y = {}
for ax, n in zip(axes.flat, cm_y):
    t = EXP[n]; yh = (t.prob.to_numpy() >= YOUDEN[n]).astype(int)
    cm = confusion_matrix(t.label, yh, labels=[0, 1]); pct = cm / cm.sum(1, keepdims=True) * 100
    ax.imshow(pct, cmap=blues, vmin=0, vmax=100); ax.grid(False)
    for i in range(2):
        for j in range(2):
            ax.text(j, i, f"{cm[i, j]}\n({pct[i, j]:.0f}%)", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8, color="white" if pct[i, j] > 55 else "#222")
    ax.set_xticks([0, 1], ["TD", "ASD"]); ax.set_yticks([0, 1], ["TD", "ASD"]); ax.set_xlabel("prediksi", fontsize=7); ax.set_ylabel("sebenarnya", fontsize=7)
    ax.set_title(n.replace("|", "\n"), fontsize=7)
    rep_y[n] = classification_report(t.label, yh, labels=[0, 1], target_names=["TD", "ASD"], output_dict=True, zero_division=0)
for ax in list(axes.flat)[len(cm_y):]: ax.axis("off")
fig.suptitle("Confusion matrix (threshold Youden per fold dari inner validation)", fontsize=10); fig.tight_layout()
savefig(fig, "12c_confusion_matrix_youden"); plt.show()
(REPORT_DIR / "classification_reports_youden.json").write_text(json.dumps(rep_y, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")

13. Efek site¶

Seberapa mudah SITE_ID ditebak dari embedding citra sebelum vs sesudah ComBat (BA tebak site; acak ≈ 1/jumlah site), lalu metrik diagnosis per site untuk kandidat fenotipik, ROI, dan fusion utama. Site dengan n < 10 atau hanya satu kelas diberi peringatan.

14. Audit reload¶

Memuat ulang checkpoint best.pt satu model citra (fold 1) beserta preprocessor input (posisi slice tetap dari template MNI, make_slices; model ini tidak memakai scaler), lalu memprediksi subjek test pertama fold tsb dalam batch yang sama seperti runner. Probabilitas harus sama dengan OOF yang tersimpan (toleransi 1e-5).

In [20]:
hp = CFG["models"][RELOAD_MODEL]
ckpt = pc.unit_dir(RESULT_DIR, f"{RELOAD_MODEL}:{RELOAD_FOLD}") / "ckpt" / "best.pt"
assert ckpt.exists(), f"checkpoint tidak ada: {ckpt}"
if hp["kind"] == "2d":
    model = pm.Slice25D(hp["timm"], hp["train_modules"], freeze_bn=hp.get("freeze_bn", False))
elif hp["kind"] == "scratch2d":
    model = pm.Scratch2D(hp["channels"], hp["dropout"])
elif hp["kind"] == "scratch3d":
    model = pm.Scratch3DSE(hp["channels"], hp["se_ratio"], hp["dropout"])
else:
    raise AssertionError(f"audit reload hanya untuk model citra end-to-end, bukan kind={hp['kind']}")
model.load_state_dict(torch.load(ckpt, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)); model = model.to(pm.DEV).eval()
test_ids = SPLITS[RELOAD_FOLD]["test"]; B = hp["batch"]; batch = test_ids[:B]; sid = int(batch[0])
Vb, Mb = pc.load_volumes(batch)
v, m = torch.from_numpy(Vb).to(pm.DEV).float(), torch.from_numpy(Mb).to(pm.DEV)
x = torch.where(m, v, torch.zeros_like(v))[:, None] if hp["kind"] == "scratch3d" else \
    pm.make_slices(v, m, pc.slice_positions(), hp.get("img_size", CFG["slices"]["size"]))
with torch.no_grad(), torch.autocast(pm.DEV.type, dtype=torch.float16):
    lg, _ = model(x)
prob_reload = float(torch.sigmoid(lg.float().cpu())[0])
oof = pd.read_csv(pc.unit_dir(RESULT_DIR, f"{RELOAD_MODEL}:{RELOAD_FOLD}") / "preds.csv")
prob_oof = float(oof[(oof.part == "test") & (oof.SUB_ID == sid)].prob.iloc[0])
diff = abs(prob_reload - prob_oof)
display(pd.DataFrame([{"model": RELOAD_MODEL, "fold": RELOAD_FOLD, "SUB_ID": sid, "prob reload": prob_reload, "prob OOF": prob_oof, "|selisih|": diff}]))
assert diff < 1e-5, f"AUDIT RELOAD GAGAL: prediksi reload {prob_reload:.6f} != OOF {prob_oof:.6f} (selisih {diff:.2e})"
RELOAD_OK = True
print("AUDIT RELOAD LULUS (selisih < 1e-5).")

15. Status run¶

run_validation.json: complete/partial, fold selesai, jumlah eksperimen, validitas OOF, hasil audit reload, dan research_result (hanya True bila SUBSET == "all" dan run lengkap). Pilot atau run parsial diberi banner peringatan.

Dari 50 perbandingan sebelum/sesudah (bugfix BN: BA/AUC/F1; Youden: BA/F1), 0 naik secara signifikan, 6 turun secara signifikan (Youden vs 0,5: tabm BA; Youden vs 0,5: tabm F1m; Youden vs 0,5: P25|F1_mean_prob BA; Youden vs 0,5: P25|F1_mean_prob F1m; Youden vs 0,5: PRI|F2_pca16_logreg BA; Youden vs 0,5: PRI|F2_pca16_logreg F1m), sisanya CI 95 % bootstrap berpasangan mencakup 0 (tanpa koreksi perbandingan berganda). Tidak ada perbaikan yang signifikan secara statistik pada n = 200. Threshold Youden menurunkan BA pada 19 dari 22 eksperimen: threshold yang dipilih dari ±32 subjek inner validation per fold tidak stabil (SD antar fold besar), sehingga pada pilot tidak memperbaiki klasifikasi. Perubahan threshold hanya menggeser trade-off sensitivitas–spesifisitas; AUC tetap.

Kandidat terkunci (seleksi inner validation, bukan skor test)¶

  • pheno: mlp_tab, tabm, logreg
  • roi: roi_tabm_cb, roi_logreg_cb
  • img25d_pretrained: resnet18, effnet_b0
  • img25d_dari_nol: scratch2d
  • img3d_dari_nol: scratch3d
  • Fusion: utama F1_stack_logreg, pembanding F1_mean_prob, F2_pca16_logreg

Interpretasi & batas validasi¶

  • Ukuran sampel. Pilot n = 200 (±40 subjek test per fold): CI 95 % lebar dan saling tumpang tindih; selisih antar model di bawah ±0,05 belum bermakna.
  • Tidak ada model yang jelas di atas acak secara kuat. BA tertinggi di test adalah PRI · F1_mean_prob (0.598 [0.530, 0.667]); ini dilaporkan, tetapi tidak dipakai untuk memilih model.
  • Seleksi via inner validation tidak stabil pada sampel kecil (±32 subjek inner val per fold): model yang terpilih tidak selalu yang terbaik di test, dan sebaliknya. Ini konsekuensi yang diterima demi mencegah kebocoran.
  • Model citra end-to-end belum belajar sinyal diagnosis (fold sudah belajar: effnet_b0 1/5, resnet18 1/5, scratch2d [lama: bug BN] 1/5, dinov2_lp n/a (probe LogReg pada fitur beku), dinov2_head 0/5, convnextv2_t 1/5, scratch3d [lama: bug BN] 0/5, sfcn_lp n/a (probe LogReg pada fitur beku), sfcn_head 4/5, scratch2d 1/5, scratch3d 0/5). Overfit test menemukan bug pada scratch2d, scratch3d (running statistics BatchNorm basi saat eval). Bugfix (kalibrasi ulang statistik BN dari inner-train tanpa augmentasi) diterapkan, overfit test lulus, dan model dilatih ulang; hasil lama ditandai tidak valid. Fusion P25/P3/PRI masih memakai anggota citra dari run lama. Penyebab per model: tabel 12a_penyebab_kegagalan_citra.
  • Registrasi hanya afin, tanpa segmentasi jaringan: fitur ROI adalah intensitas rata-rata/SD per region atlas, bukan volume/ketebalan; variasi anatomi lokal tidak dinormalisasi.
  • Efek site kuat: embedding citra mengandung informasi site (BA tebak site jauh di atas acak); ComBat menghapusnya, tetapi akurasi diagnosis tidak ikut naik. Generalisasi ke site baru (LOSO) belum diuji.
  • Threshold: dilaporkan dua versi — 0,5 tetap dan Youden per fold dari inner validation (aturan dikunci untuk data penuh). Youden hanya menggeser trade-off sensitivitas–spesifisitas; AUC tidak berubah. Inner validation pilot kecil (±32 subjek/fold), sehingga threshold Youden sendiri tidak stabil antar fold.
  • SFCN (brain age UK Biobank) dikeluarkan berdasarkan cek kewajaran pada subjek ≥ 18 tahun (n = 67): r = -0.13, SD prediksi 0.61 th (aturan: |r| ≥ 0,3 dan SD ≥ 2 th). Rentang usia model 42–82 th, sedangkan median usia subjek 23 th.
  • Signifikansi: hanya perbandingan sebelum/sesudah (bugfix, Youden) yang diuji dengan bootstrap berpasangan; perbandingan antar model belum diuji (mis. DeLong / permutation test) dan bersifat deskriptif.
  • Test held-out (149 subjek) belum dipakai; evaluasi akhir dilakukan sekali setelah konfigurasi data penuh dikunci.

17. Referensi & menjalankan ulang untuk data penuh¶

Data & preprocessing. Di Martino et al. 2014, The Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE I), Mol Psychiatry · Tustison et al. 2010, N4ITK, IEEE TMI · Isensee et al. 2019, HD-BET, Hum Brain Mapp (bobot HD-BET v2.0.1) · Avants et al. 2011, ANTs, NeuroImage · Fonov et al. 2011, MNI152 2009, NeuroImage · Desikan et al. 2006 / Makris et al. 2006, atlas Harvard-Oxford (FSL, maxprob thr25 2 mm).

Harmonisasi. Johnson et al. 2007, ComBat, Biostatistics · Fortin et al. 2018, ComBat untuk MRI struktural, NeuroImage · Pomponio et al. 2020, neuroHarmonize, NeuroImage.

Model. He et al. 2016, ResNet (resnet18.a1_in1k) · Tan & Le 2019, EfficientNet (efficientnet_b0.ra_in1k) · Woo et al. 2023, ConvNeXt V2 (convnextv2_tiny.fcmae_ft_in22k_in1k) · Oquab et al. 2023, DINOv2 (vit_small_patch14_dinov2.lvd142m) · Peng et al. 2021, SFCN brain age UK Biobank, Med Image Anal (bobot run_20190719_00_epoch_best_mae.p, MIT) · Hu et al. 2018, Squeeze-and-Excitation, CVPR · Kumar et al. 2022, LP-FT, ICLR · Chen & Guestrin 2016, XGBoost, KDD · Gorishniy et al. 2025, TabM, ICLR · Wightman, timm (PyTorch Image Models).

Evaluasi. Efron & Tibshirani 1993, bootstrap CI · Brodersen et al. 2010, balanced accuracy.

Menjalankan ulang untuk data penuh

  1. Preprocessing sisa subjek: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\resume_05c.ps1 -Mode all -StopAt 07:00 (ulang tiap malam sampai EXIT CODE: 0).
  2. Runner data penuh dengan konfigurasi terkunci: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\run_pilot.ps1 -Subset all.
  3. Di sel CONFIG: RESULT_DIR = Path(r"C:\ta_local\results\all_v2"), SUBSET = "all", LOCKED_CONFIG = Path(r"C:\ta_local\results\pilot200_v2\locked_config_kandidat.json"). THRESHOLD tetap 0,5.
  4. Restart & Run All. Semua assert harus lulus; run_validation.json → research_result = true.
  5. Export HTML: .venv-model\Scripts\python.exe -m jupyter nbconvert --to html notebook\06_modeling_report.ipynb.
